_doc: The hub's guard. Filed by `rules/addrule.py --contract hub --rule ... --quote ... --suppress <regex>` from the owner's own sentences; matched case-insensitively against a card's text + context on every POST /pending. downgrade = posted as an update (told, not asked); drop = kept with its #N but nothing is pushed.

downgrade.note: never ask to confirm what was already instructed
